meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 项目管理专家与产品经理在做项目决策、技术评审或商业策略制定时，当需要多视角碰撞以打破思维局限，请用此技能模拟多智能体真实会议辩论，一键生成包含决策结论、核心论据与风险提示的完整会议记录，让复杂决策高效落地！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟多方辩论，一键产出含结论与风险的会议纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常陷于单视角决策，需要多方观点碰撞来拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Generate decision-ready meeting notes from a multi-perspective debate.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multi-perspective input before finalizing a project decision.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟 3-5 个不同专业背景与性格的 AI 角色开会，围绕你的议题依次开场发言、自由讨论、辩论并收敛共识，最终输出含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要多角度分析问题、需要不同领域专业知识碰撞，或要做项目决策、技术评审、商业策略制定时触发。

say.text: 帮我开一场会议：是否采用微服务架构，角色配技术架构师、DevOps工程师、CTO
say.note: 会按角色依次发言辩论并给结论

say.text: 用产品经理、市场分析师、销售总监、财务顾问开一场新产品定价策略会议
say.note: 输出定价方案对比与收益评估

say.text: 开一场项目风险评估会，请项目经理、技术专家、法务顾问参加
say.note: 输出风险清单与应对措施

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude simulates 3-5 AI agents with different backgrounds and personalities holding a meeting: opening statements, free discussion, debate, and convergence. It ends with a meeting record containing the decision, key arguments, risks, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need multi-perspective analysis, cross-domain expertise, or a decision on project planning, technical review, or business strategy.

say_en.text: Hold a meeting on whether to adopt microservices, with a tech architect, a DevOps engineer and a CTO
say_en.note: Agents speak in turn, debate, then decide

say_en.text: Run a pricing strategy meeting with a PM, a market analyst, a sales director and a finance advisor
say_en.note: Outputs pricing options and revenue estimates

say_en.text: Run a project risk assessment meeting with a project manager, a tech expert and a legal advisor
say_en.note: Outputs a risk list and responses
